subject: Post-call recap & timing check — ToscaWorks procurement
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cooper <alyssa@toscaworks.com>
Cc: Devon Price <devon.price@toscaworks.com>
Date: 2025-06-24T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap & timing check — ToscaWorks procurement

Hi Alyssa & Devon,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier — good to meet you both. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Priority: You mentioned platform search and personalization as near-term priorities for H2; goal is to pilot on a single product line (Checkout flow).
- Technical fit: Our streaming generation + prefix caching should keep latency under 120ms for your typical 64-token responses (we'll size batch config during POC).
- Security/compliance: attached is the starter MAP and the small security checklist you requested. We can run the security review in parallel with the POC.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send a short MAP and an initial commercial proposal (attached).
2) Devon, can you confirm who needs to sign off on budget? From the call it sounded like VP Ops + Procurement.
3) If you're ok, we suggest a 4-week POC starting ASAP — we can scope a pilot that stays under your procurement threshold.

As we get closer to the quarter close, I want to check timing/priority: is this Q2 close or pushed to next quarter for budget approval? If it’s flexible, we can offer a short start-with-credit approach to accelerate pilot without a full PO.

Attachments: 2025-06-24-ToscaWorks-MAP.xlsx (MAP), redwood-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal, pricing outline)

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

From: Alyssa Cooper <alyssa@toscaworks.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Price <devon.price@toscaworks.com>
Date: 2025-06-25T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & timing check — ToscaWorks procurement

Hi Chloe,

Appreciate the clear summary and the MAP — looks good. A couple quick notes from our side:

- Budget: Finance is doing the mid-year budget review next week; no firm yes yet.
- Stakeholders: I’ll loop in Lina (VP Ops) once we have a POC draft; Devon is our internal technical lead for the pilot.
- Timeline: We’re trying to prioritize pilots that can show impact before the end of the quarter, but I can’t guarantee approvals this week.

Please send the proposal and any optional low-friction pilot terms (start-with-credit, limited scope POC). We’re keen but I need to confirm the timing internally.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Head of Product | ToscaWorks
alyssa@toscaworks.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cooper <alyssa@toscaworks.com>
Cc: Devon Price <devon.price@toscaworks.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-02T16:28:00Z
Subject: Quick nudge — EoQ priority & approval timeline?

Hi Alyssa / Devon — bumping this thread as we head into the final two weeks of the quarter.

Short ask: can you confirm whether (a) budget/PO is likely to clear before next Friday, or (b) we should plan for an early-Q3 start? If (b), would you still be open to a small, non-PO POC to get technical work underway while approvals finish? We’ve used the start-with-credit approach a few times for customers in similar situations.

If helpful I can also pull a one-time promotional credit (need sign-off from Sales Ops). Looping Sergio here to indicate we may need a short authorization if you want an upfront credit to unblock the pilot.

If I don’t hear back, I’ll follow up with a one-line check-in next week.

Best,
Chloe

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Price <devon.price@toscaworks.com>, Alyssa Cooper <alyssa@toscaworks.com>
Date: 2025-07-09T11:05:00Z
Subject: Internal: quick approval ask if Tosca needs start-with-credit

Sergio / Hannah — copying the customer for transparency. 

ToscaWorks is interested but budget sign-off may slip past EoQ. If they want a limited POC before the PO, I may need permission to extend a $7.5k one-time credit (applies to first month of POC usage). Can you confirm whether Sales Ops can approve this level without exec sign-off?

Notes: 4-week POC scoped to Checkout product line; expected token run ~10M tokens/month during POC. If we do start-with-credit, we’ll require a short MSA addendum and a commitment to review results at end of POC (formal PO expected for production).

If you approve, I’ll offer the option to Alyssa and expedite contract addendum.

Thanks,
Chloe

From: Alyssa Cooper <alyssa@toscaworks.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Price <devon.price@toscaworks.com>
Date: 2025-07-15T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & timing check — ToscaWorks procurement

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the follow ups and for the internal coordination. Quick update from our side:

- Priority shift: our leadership asked us to re-evaluate Q2 pilots; this one is now deprioritized for immediate EoQ roll (we’ve moved some non-critical pilots to early Q3).
- Budget: finance has deferred a small set of pilot approvals to July; we expect to have clarity in the first two weeks of July.
- Next step: Devon and I still want to run the POC, but we need a compact commercial option. The start-with-credit approach sounds ideal — can you share the exact terms and a short addendum template?

If you can send the addendum and the one-line confirmation of the $7.5k credit option, I’ll expedite internal approval and loop Lina for final sign-off. Appreciate you staying flexible.

Best,
Alyssa
